_comment: Offline map packages Roadguard can install.
The archive is a whole-of-Australia Shortbread 1.0 PMTiles built from OpenStreetMap data with
planetiler (see tools/build_australia_pmtiles.sh) and published as a release asset of this
repository. It is self-hosted deliberately: the OpenStreetMap data is ODbL and free to
redistribute, but the public extract servers (Geofabrik, BBBike, Protomaps, VersaTiles) either
discourage per-install traffic or are donation funded, so pointing an app's first-run download
at them would be abusive. Build once, host once, attribute properly.
sizeBytes and sha256 are filled in by tools/build_australia_pmtiles.sh from the artifact it
actually produced; the app verifies the download against them.

packages.description: Whole-of-Australia offline road map. Installed once, then works with no SIM, no mobile data and no Wi-Fi.
